description: Audited allow-list for tools/check_fabrication_idioms.mjs (front-office#108). Every entry names an exact file, rule, specific regex pattern, and a verified one-line justification from inspecting that file.

entries.justification: Fixed 3x3 Statcast strike-zone geometric grid bin boundaries (horizontal [-0.85, 0.85] ft, vertical [1.5, 3.5] ft).
Seeded (set.seed(20261018)) 1,000-season Monte Carlo MLB season and postseason simulator in simulate_variant_seasons().
Fallback projected plate appearances (0.85 * prior PA, bounded [150, 650]) used only via coalesce() when Marcel proj_pa is NA.
Canonical 30-team MLB franchise ID, abbreviation, league, and division lookup table in get_canonical_mlb_teams().
7-bin reliability calibration bin break edges and midpoints ([0.0, 1.0]) for walk-forward diagnostics.
Vectorized NBA CBA Article VII $5M progressive luxury-tax bracket width slicing in compute_luxury_tax().
2023 NBA CBA Article VII standard and repeater luxury-tax bracket multiplier schedules.
Verified 2026-11-12 Spotrac NBA team payroll snapshot fallback used only when live BBRef caches are missing or unreadable.
Physical [0, 100]% boundary clamp on empirical clutch usage ratio (player possessions / team possessions).
Standard True Shooting percentage formula PTS / (2 * (FGA + 0.44 * FTA)) bounded to physical [0, 100]% range.
Empirical Usage/Self-Creation Index product ((unassisted FGM% / 100) * clutch PPP * 100) bounded to [0, 150].
30-team NBA coaching staff registry table (runif() purged under #80; hand-typed career record tracked under #188).
15-pseudo-count positional Dirichlet smoothing priors (G/F/C) for low-sample NBA matchup distributions.
Documented 4-model ensemble blend weights (35% bottom-up, 25% RAPM, 20% shot/fatigue, 20% embeddings) in GAME_DETAIL_ENSEMBLE_WEIGHTS.
Legacy continuity fallback in legacy_continuity() used only if offseason_teams.json lacks roster_continuity_pct (0/30 missing).
Audited 60-pick 2026-27 NBA draft class prospect catalog and scouting table verified under NBA #18/#19.
Physical half-court basketball y-coordinate alignment (+4.0 ft hoop offset clamped to [0, 47] ft court length).
Empirical stats::ecdf() quantile mapping rescaling observed NFL player distributions onto [15.0, 99.0] display range.
Official 15-team WNBA head coach directory carrying explicit REGISTRY_SOURCE_CITATION and REGISTRY_VERIFIED_DATE.
Physical half-court basketball y-coordinate alignment (+4.0 ft hoop offset clamped to [0, 47] ft court length).
Seeded (set.seed(42 + ...)) 10,000-trial Bernoulli playoff series simulator inside simulate_web_matchup().
44-game WNBA season team win bounds [10, 36] applied to RAPM, shot-fatigue, and embedding team projection variants.
Normal CDF playoff qualification probability centered at 21.0 WNBA wins bounded to [0.01, 0.999].
Deterministic zero-sample player availability fallback (proj_games_floor) used only when season_games is NA, per WNBA #149/#158.
Standard 8-player WNBA 40-minute regulation playoff rotation minute template (sums to 200 team minutes).
Matches the ESPN play-by-play event type 'Technical Free Throw' to leave technical free throws out of free-throw attempt counts; it filters an event type, not a player name.
Momentum score component weights: a documented design choice (comment above the constant), published on the page in methods.combined_score.weights; not observed data.
Points per made field goal by shot zone (rim and mid-range are two-point shots, three-pointers score 3): basketball scoring rules.
ESPN season-type codes (2 regular season, 3 postseason, 5 play-in) selecting the prior season's games that seed the Elo carry-over.
